reviews.body:
Nice catch @pcbeingused333, that system turn really was the literal string `DEFAULT_PROMPT` going to the model on every call.

The change in `pkg/ai/amazonsagemaker.go` reads right to me: one user message carrying the caller's prompt, sampling parameters untouched, and the new test reads the InvokeEndpoint body to pin it.

One thing to fix: `golangci-lint` is red at `3a6d787`. The job runs with `only-new-issues`, so the four `github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/...` imports in the new `pkg/ai/amazonsagemaker_test.go` (lines 11 to 14) each trip staticcheck SA1019, since SDK v1 is deprecated. The backend itself still uses v1, so the test has to as well. Add `//nolint:staticcheck` to those four import lines (a short note that the backend is still on v1 helps) and this should go green.
